inclusions.source: A one-hour dolphin performance at Hurghada's Dolphin House, with private return hotel transfers included.
Hurghada Dolphin Show: Tickets & Hotel Transfer

inclusions.text: Private air-conditioned vehicle for the hotel transfer
inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party in an air-conditioned vehicle; the show itself is a shared, ticketed performance at a fixed venue.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person for the transfer
inclusions.source: The outing takes bookings from a single person upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided for the transfer.
